terms.gloss: a vacuum cleaner that works by itself
terms.comment: Traupman’s vacuum cleaner (see vacuum) with automatus, self-moving (Petr. 50.1, Lewis & Short), the adjective the modern works use for machines that work by themselves (see automated testing). No reference work has a word for the robot itself. At home robōtum alone is enough when only one robot cleans the floor.

phrases.english: The robot vacuum has got stuck under the bed.
The robot is cleaning the floor; lift your feet!

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, pp. 39, 371.
Lewis & Short: automatus · Lewis & Short: haurio
